feedback: The candidate does not faithfully encode the task, which requires that after every fall the agent picks the box up on its very next move. In state u1 the transition (u1, !box_fell) -> u2 fires on any step without a fall, including when the agent is still not holding the box: a delayed pickup (or no pickup at all) would pass through u1 and earn the 0.2 progress reward with no way to detect the violation. To enforce 'very next move', u1 must only advance to the success/pickup state when holding_box becomes true (e.g., (u1, holding_box & !box_fell) -> u2), and staying empty-handed must remain in u1 or trigger an explicit regression/penalty. Also note the constraint that box_fell and holding_box never hold together, so the pickup guard should reflect the pickup step semantics (holding_box true and box_fell false on that step). Finally, missing explicit reward entry: if the agent reaches at_exit while holding_box but a fall occurred on a prior step and was handled correctly this is fine, but there is no path in u1 to uexit, so an agent that picks up the box after the fall and then exits transitions u1 -> u2 only via !box_fell — meaning the exit-with-box reward is reachable, but the next-move requirement is unenforced. Fix the u1 transition condition as above; otherwise accept: format (STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES/TRANSITION_FUNCTION/REWARD_FUNCTION), predicate-only events, per-state else self-loops covering irrelevant events, bounded dense progress rewards, and explicit final state uexit all check out.
